svg.text: SIS: LOGIC SOLVER SEPARATE FROM DCS, DE-ENERGISE TO TRIP;
TRIP SIGNALS TO PUMP MOTORS AND XV-119 NOT SHOWN (SEE SCHEDULE).
CONTROL VALVE, FC / FO = FAIL CLOSED / OPEN
LINE No.: DNxx-SERVICE-NNN (AQ FEED · SV SOLVENT · RF RAFFINATE · EX EXTRACT · VT VENT)
ALL TRIPS LATCH; RESET AT THE SIS AFTER THE CAUSE CLEARS.
I-1, I-2, ESD = UNIT TRIP WITH FIRST-OUT.
1. ALTERNATIVE VERSION, EPC STANDARD. THE SCREEN DRAWING RDC-PID-001 REV B STAYS THE REFERENCE FOR THE DCS, DECKS AND EXERCISES.
2. DESIGN POINT FROM THE OTS MODEL: FEED 1000 kg/h 45 wt% ACETONE, TCE 350 kg/h (S/F 0.35), RAFFINATE 549 kg/h, EXTRACT 801 kg/h,
1.0 barg, 25 °C, ROTOR 180 rpm. MASS BALANCE CLOSES (1350 IN = 1350 OUT kg/h).
3. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY (VELOCITY 0.3–0.6 m/s); MATERIAL SPEC TBC. PRESSURE INSTRUMENTS C/W ROOT AND TEST VALVES (TYP., NOT SHOWN).
4. PSV-108 SET 3.5 barg = DESIGN PRESSURE OF C-101 (ASSUMED); ORIFICE ON THE FIRE CASE (RDC-PE-RLB-001); ≤ 10 % ACCUM. (EQ-03 CLOSED).
5. PT-108 FEEDS PIC-108 AND PSHH-108; LT-109 FEEDS LIC-109, LSLL-109 AND LSHH-109 (AS MODELLED). SEE HAZOP R-18 / LOPA.
6. T-101: N₂ BLANKET, VENT THROUGH PVRV + FLAME ARRESTER (HAZOP R-02; EQ-01 CLOSED). C-101 DESIGN 3.5 barg / 120 °C (EQ-09).
7. DRAINS TO THE CLOSED DRAIN (CD) SYSTEM; NO OPEN DRAINS IN TCE SERVICE.
8. DRAWN BY APINAN SOOTTITANTAWAT. NUMBERS FROM THE SIMULATOR MODEL; ISSUED FOR TEACHING.
DN25-AQ-105 Feed from upstream to T-101
DN25-AQ-107 P-101 discharge to FV-101 / E-101
DN15-SV-101 Recovered TCE from C-103 to D-102
DN15-SV-103 P-102 discharge to FV-103 / E-102
DN25-VT-111 PSV-108 outlet to closed vent
